title: Piri Reis map showing Antarctica

tellings.quote: It's like the map of Piri Race where you have the sort of uh tropical parts of Antarctica that are shown uh you know at the top.

plain: An old map known as the Piri Reis map, according to Jesse Michels, shows parts of Antarctica without ice, looking tropical. Michels mentions it himself while talking with others, along with another old map called the Oronteus Finaeus map, and links the idea to the writer Graham Hancock. The point is that if the map is read this way, someone mapped Antarctica before it was covered in ice, long before any known civilization could have.
